Name: Joja Movie Theater and Super Jojamart
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Have a little taste of my hometown on the Joja route. Like any self-respecting big box store, they leave behind their older, smaller buildings to rot while they hermit crab their way to a bigger and better one. And maybe one day, something will pick up that old shell.

On the Joja route, Jojamart will start fixing up the community center and use it as a temporary warehouse until they can finish (and fund) remodeling. When it is complete, it will be a new Super Jojamart! The old Jojamart will be left to rot like any old big box store out there, at least until you can fork over enough to have it redone as a movie theater. The theater will still look like the Joja theater on the inside, the outside will simply be the old Jojamart with some movie signage, fixed up... mostly.

Since magical little apple spirits are involved, the Community Center route will be visually unchanged unless you use the override.
[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Changes the look of the Jojamart warehouse to something less fully remodeled since it's in progress. Patched up, Jojafied.[/*]
[*]Moves the Jojamart to the Community Center as a Super Jojamart after you finish the Joja route. They remodel it with the money they saved getting you to pay for repairs.[/*]
[*]Minor interior changes to imply a bigger store, including Morris getting a new office with his promotion. (If you don't have SVE, where he already has an office)[/*]
[*]Changes the Joja route end event to the grand opening of the Super Jojamart.[/*]
[*]The old Jojamart will lie in ruins until you pay to turn it into a movie theater. It has a new appearance that reflects the fact that it's squatting in an old Jojamart.[/*]
[*]What little text there is that refers to the warehouse will be altered to refer to it as a temporary warehouse and future Super Jojamart.[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Requirements[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-78233998.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Requires Midnight's Misc Tilesheets[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Compatibility[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906055-1085614367.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Marry Morris, SVE, East Scarp, Claire the Part Timer, Solstice Winter Star, and Feast of the Sun compatibility is included. Morris Redeemed and Seven Deadly Sins do not need it, to my knowledge.[/*]
[*]Morris's 8h event for SVE will have a variant if the Super Jojamart is open when it fires that takes place in the back rooms and some of its text will be altered to match. I have also altered references to the warehouse in SVE to refer to a temporary warehouse and future Super Jojamart for consistency.[/*]
[*]CJB Cheats will have updated locations and conditions.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Earthy, VPR, and Starblue recolors and Overgrown Vintage map. Settings for manual and automatic color selection.[/*]
[*]My changes to the Jojamart are minimal, structurally speaking, so that events that take place in there should look right. (These changes apply in a lesser capacity to the SVE version, since mainly I make the Jojamart look more like SVE's) It also only happens after you finish the Joja route. If it causes any problems on your setup, I have included a setting to remove the interior changes altogether.[/*]
[*]I have not considered Wayback or Rurals of Italy for this, because their Jojamarts don't really fit the aesthetic of what I'm going for here, AKA "obvious big box building that has clearly been repurposed to become something else." You can still technically use it with either, but it will be weird with way Back and you should turn off the Jojamart for Rurals of Italy.[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Credits[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-1881551726.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]EnderTedi, commissioned for the C# component of this mod! Without it, the theater wouldn't move properly and none of my map patches would work.[/*]
[*]FlashShifter for the rough design of the Jojamart upgrade in SVE![/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Permission[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906055-1428082624.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[list]
[*][b]NO AI FOR ANY PURPOSE. ART OR WRITING OR ANYTHING.[/b][/*]
[*]If you want to translate this mod NOT using AI, then go for it. As long as it's only the translation files and not the entire mod being re-uploaded, I do not mind.[/*]
[/list]
